criteria.criterion: The durable operator contract is complete and rollback-safe: every pause blob retains `gated_mode: reconcile-check` plus `paused/reason/who/paused_at`; the pre-change decoder accepts it; repository git email and first-pause RFC3339 provenance are enforced; blank, missing-identity, missing-remote, different-reason, and CAS-conflict cases refuse without overwrite; same-reason pause is metadata-stable; resume is observed-OID CAS and clears absent, valid, or corrupt state safely.

Runtime and workflow behavior is complete without regressions: pause and corrupt-gate paths return before lock/pass/ticket mutation; pause emits only the exact anchored four-key rc-0 `BRIDGE_PAUSED` line and skips scheduled commit-and-push; corrupt state emits the exact rc-1 recovery line without traceback and is repaired by resume; ordinary success, malformed or unanchored markers, legacy gate rc 4, benign/generic mappings, old `rebar reconcile --mode`, and the pre-gate `reconcile-check` return remain functional.

The staged public contract and exclusions are complete: CLI help, generated reference, user guide, exit-code docs, and release notes expose `preview/sync/pause/resume`; no `--until`, automatic expiry, new-only blob, gate rename, or old-vocabulary removal shipped.
